sources.snippet: Gemma 4 12B IT Qat Q4 0 Unquantized — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Chat Gemma 4 12B IT Qat Q4 0 Unquantized is a 12.0B-parameter open language model from Google in the Gemma 4 family.
